title: Knowledge article frontmatter
description: Frontmatter of a knowledge article under data/knowledge/articles. An article explains a topic beyond a single species; the body cites the sources with Markdown footnote references such as [^key]. Source and provenance shapes are those of data/species/schema/species-profile.schema.json, which must be registered with the validator under its $id.

id.description: Slug of the article; the file is named <id>.md.

species.description: Ids of the species profiles the article is about; may be empty.

waterbodies.description: Ids of the entries of data/species/waterbodies.yaml the article is about; may be empty.

sources.description: Sources by citation key; the body cites a key as [^key].
